rendered.line: Hi, I'm Sarah. Let me show you how to place your first order with Canoe Demo, Wasaga Beach.

rendered.label: Corner transition
rendered.line: Let's get started. Here are the steps to complete your first canoe rental.

scenes.line: Enter your email, and we'll send you a 4 digit verification code you can add here to sign in securely.
From your dashboard, tap New Order to begin. This is also where your orders are listed, so you can find them again later.
Add a person to the order — yourself, or a party member — so we know who's paddling.
Search for a canoe or kayak, or choose one from a collection. The collections hold groups of boats, which can come in different sizes.
Select your rental starting date, then your return date. You'll see the number of days update as you choose, so you can check the length of your trip before you continue.
Add the canoe to your order.
Please review and agree to the rental terms, then save. There are no extra questions for this rental, so you're nearly done.
Enter your credit card details to complete your rental order. Your payment is processed securely.
That's it — your order is complete. Your invoice is ready, and your canoe will be waiting for you at the store.
You'll always find your rental in your order history, so you can check the details any time. Enjoy the water!
